**Downlink data for an idle UE pages it**

| | |
|---|---|
| Group | NAS / 5GMM connection management procedures / Paging procedure |
| Tags | none |
| Verdict class | FAIL |
| Requires | Rel-15 |
| Up to | 30s at the default `--per-test-timeout` |
| Phase | main |
| Needs | NG Setup, registration, PDU session establishment, AN release |

## Clauses

- TS 24.501 5.6.2.2.1 (Rel-15 onward; Rel-15: V15.0.0 reads "in 5GMM-IDLE mode"; "over 3GPP access" is added by V15.7.0; Rel-17: adds "and there is no paging restriction applied in the network for that paging")
- TS 23.502 4.2.3.3 step 4b (Rel-15 onward; Rel-15: V15.0.0 reads "reachable" and "Paging Priority indication"; "reachable in 3GPP access" and "Paging Priority" by V15.17.0; Rel-16: the Paging message's content adds Enhanced Coverage Restricted information and WUS Assistance Information; "the AMF sends a Paging message" is unchanged)
- TS 38.413 8.5.1.2 (Rel-15 onward; Rel-15: V15.0.0 reads "paging procedure" and "List of TAIs"; "Paging procedure" and "TAI List for Paging" from V15.1.0; Rel-16: Rel-16 to Rel-19 add optional-IE sentences only)
- TS 38.413 9.2.4.1 (Rel-15 onward; Rel-15: "List of TAIs" is renamed "TAI List for Paging" in V15.1.0; V15.0.0 also carries "UE Identity Index Value", absent by V19.4.0 (removal version not traced))
- TS 38.413 9.3.3.18 (Rel-15 onward, wording unchanged through Rel-19)

The quoted normative text and the release history of each clause are in the check's [provenance](https://github.com/grewelltech/orbit/blob/main/docs/conformance/provenance/NGAP-PAGING-ON-DL-DATA.md).
